messages:
Maya (CS): Hey team — AcmeRetail POC stuck: dedicated GPU pool provisioning in us-central1 keeps failing with quota + subnet errors, customer blocked. Can we swarm?
Ali (Sales): Thanks Maya — customer is on a tight timeline, asking if fallback region is ok (they prefer US). Pricing Q too: will reserved capacity pricing change if we switch region?
Sam (Eng Platform): @Ali pricing same per-region list price but commit may vary, need to confirm capacity availability. Can we get exact error logs?
Maya (CS): Pasting error from Provisioner UI: 
```
ERROR: Allocation failed: InsufficientIPs: subnet 10.2.0.0/22 has 0 available addresses
CausedBy: quotaExceeded: GPU quota (a2-highgpu) exceeded in us-central1
RequestID: prov-8a3f
```
Maya (CS): Customer ran into VPC with tight subnet masks (their infra team carved /22 only for pods). Also their cloud account shows GPU quota at 0 for that project.
Jorge (Infra): @Maya two issues: 1) subnet exhaustion — need larger CIDR or secondary IP range for pods; 2) quota — they need to request GPU quota increase or we can provision in a different project/region.
Jorge (Infra): Quick triage commands we suggested to customer: 
```
gcloud compute networks subnets describe acme-prod-subnet --region=us-central1
gcloud compute regions describe us-central1 --project=acme-prod
```
Sam (Eng Platform): We can also offer a temporary workaround: spin pool in us-east1 where quota shows available, and use routing policy to direct traffic there. Need approval from customer for cross-region latency.
Ali (Sales): Customer asked about SLA differences across regions and egress considerations. Also wants to keep data in US only.
Lisa (Security): Data residency ok if within US regions. Need to confirm encryption keys: if they use customer-managed KMS, ensure we have key in target region. Also want audit log delivery to their SIEM — flagging for later.
Maya (CS): Customer is nervous about switching region because their network team wants static egress IPs for allowlisting.
Jorge (Infra): We can support static NAT via our egress NAT gateway but it’s an extra config; ask them to allow our egress IP block or provide a proxy in their VPC.
Sam (Eng Platform): Action items: 
- (Sam) attempt provisioning in us-east1 dev account with same pool config to validate runtime behavior (ETA 1h)
- (Jorge) draft exact subnet resizing steps and docs to share with customer's infra (ETA 30m)
- (Maya) ask customer to submit GPU quota increase to cloud console (we'll provide template)
- (Lisa) confirm KMS region and audit log endpoints with customer (ETA today)
Maya (CS): I'll send the quota-request template and a short doc on fallback tradeoffs.
Ali (Sales): Also need to answer pricing Q: if they commit to 3-month reserved capacity and we provision in east instead of central, will pricing/discounts apply? @Sam any pointer?
Sam (Eng Platform): Pricing invariant in our system for same SKU, but committed capacity billing is tied to account/contract — ops will confirm if cross-region changes impact billing. I'll tag finance.
deploy-bot: Provision attempt #5 failed at 14:22 UTC: insufficient ips (provisioner/prov-8a3f). See run logs: https://ci.internal/prov/8a3f
Maya (CS): Customer ok to try us-east for now if we can guarantee static egress and KMS. They're provisioning test data now.
Jorge (Infra): Sending step-by-step subnet expansion for them now. If they can't expand, we can propose using secondary ranges + alias IPs — lower disruption.
Lisa (Security): If they use C-M KMS, we must have key policy grant to our service account in target region. I'll prepare exact policy snippet.
Maya (CS): Great. I'll coordinate with customer's infra and keep channel updated. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Ali (Sales): Appreciate the quick swarm — keep me posted on any blocker that affects PoC timeline or pricing commitments.
Sam (Eng Platform): Will follow up when us-east test completes (or sooner if blocked).
Maya (CS): Closing loop: last status 14:58 UTC — customer expanding subnet now, they also requested the quota request template.
